title.zh: 授权向八打雁省贷款一千美元（美金），以使该省议会能通过贷款或其他方式应对八打雁市镇因市场火灾导致大量民众无家可归的紧急状况的法案
title.en: AN ACT TO AUTHORIZE A LOAN OF ONE THOUSAND DOLLARS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS TO ENABLE THE PROVINCIAL BOARD TO MAKE PROVISION, BY LOAN OR OTHERWISE, TO MEET THE EMERGENCY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BATANGAS CAUSED BY A FIRE DESTROYING THE MARKET AND RENDERING HOMELESS A LARGE NUMBER OF PEOPLE.
title.orig: AN ACT TO AUTHORIZE A LOAN OF ONE THOUSAND DOLLARS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS TO ENABLE THE PROVINCIAL BOARD TO MAKE PROVISION, BY LOAN OR OTHERWISE, TO MEET THE EMERGENCY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BATANGAS CAUSED BY A FIRE DESTROYING THE MARKET AND RENDERING HOMELESS A LARGE NUMBER OF PEOPLE.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép vay một nghìn đô la Mỹ cho Tỉnh Batangas để Hội đồng Tỉnh có thể bố trí nguồn lực, bằng hình thức vay hoặc cách khác, giải quyết tình trạng khẩn cấp tại thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Batangas do vụ cháy phá hủy chợ và khiến nhiều người mất nhà
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้กู้ยืมหนึ่งพันดอลลาร์สหรัฐอเมริกาแก่จังหวัดบาตังกัสเพื่อให้สภาจังหวัดสามารถจัดเตรียมมาตรการโดยการกู้ยืมหรือวิธีอื่นเพื่อรับมือกับสถานการณ์ฉุกเฉินในอำเภอบาตังกัสซึ่งเกิดจากเหตุเพลิงไหม้ทำลายตลาดและทำให้ประชาชนจำนวนมากไร้ที่อยู่อาศัย
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan pinjaman seribu dolar Amerika Serikat kepada Provinsi Batangas agar Dewan Provinsi dapat menyediakan ketentuan, melalui pinjaman atau cara lain, guna menghadapi keadaan darurat di Kotamadya Batangas akibat kebakaran yang menghancurkan pasar dan membuat sejumlah besar orang kehilangan tempat tinggal
title.ms: Akta mengizinkan pinjaman seribu dolar Amerika Syarikat kepada Wilayah Batangas bagi membolehkan Lembaga Wilayah membuat peruntukan, melalui pinjaman atau cara lain, untuk menghadapi kecemasan dalam Perbandaran Batangas yang disebabkan oleh kebakaran yang memusnahkan pasar dan menyebabkan ramai rakyat kehilangan rumah

text.en:
The provincial board of Batangas is hereby authorized to borrow, by resolution, from the Insular
Treasury, the same to be paid out of the three-million-dollar relief fund, the sum of one thousand dollars,
United States currency; said sum to be used by provincial board as it may deem wise in aid of the
municipality Batangas to meet the emergency presented by a fire destroying its market and rendering
homeless a large number of its people. The sum thus borrowed shall be repaid by the provincial board
without interest to the Insular Treasurer on or before the expiration of two years from the date of the loan.
The amount loaned shall be paid to the provincial treasurer of Batangas upon receipt by the Insular Treasurer
of a resolution of the provincial board accepting the loan and agreeing to repay the same as by this section

There is hereby appropriated, out of the three-million-dollar relief fund voted by the Congress of
the United States for use in the Philippine Islands, the sum of one thousand dollars, United States currency,
to comply with the provisions of this Act.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 30, 1903.
